prompt: Add a --verbose flag to cli.py that sets the log level to DEBUG.
message: Added `--verbose` to `cli.py`, which sets the log level to `DEBUG` instead of `INFO` when passed.
diff:
diff --git a/cli.py b/cli.py
index 4bb1080..5f623a3 100644
--- a/cli.py
+++ b/cli.py
@@ -6,8 +6,9 @@ def main():
     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
     parser.add_argument("path")
     parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
+    parser.add_argument("--verbose", action="store_true")
     args = parser.parse_args()
-    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
+    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.DEBUG if args.verbose else logging.INFO)
     logging.info("processing %s", args.path)
